The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Lavos

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nova

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: <ARCHWING> Odonata

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Banshee

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Octavia

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Valkyr

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These talons emerge when Valkyr unleashes her Hysteria.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Valkyr Talons

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Atlas' deadly fists, as utilized by his Landslide Ability.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Landslide Fists

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Atlas

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Xaku

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Jade

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Qorvex

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Mesa

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dagath

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Uriel

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Grendel

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Chroma

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Radial Blind

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: DARK EXCALIBUR PRIME

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Summon a sword of pure light and immense power.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Exalted Blade

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon these mighty dual pistols.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dex Pixia

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon this formidable heavy blade.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Diwata

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Titania

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a grenade that completely freezes enemies with a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect, leaving a freezing zone that continues to apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status for a duration.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Neutralizer

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These nasty things come out when Garuda forgoes a melee weapon.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Garuda Talons

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Garuda

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Citrine

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Gara's devastating Shattered Lash, created by her Shattered lash ability.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Shattered Lash

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gara

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gyre

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Mirage

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Styanax

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nidus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Follie

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Charges up and releases bolts of Balefire.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Balefire Charger

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Hildryn

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nyx

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Khora's loyal Kavat. Her constant companion and protector.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Venari

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Khora

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Khora's deadly exalted whip, unleased by her Whipclaw ability.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Whipclaw

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Koumei

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Limbo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Wukong

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A unique staff wielded by the Wukong Warframe.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Iron Staff

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nekros

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nezha

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ash

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Ash's fearsome Shadow Clones, as projected by his Blade Storm ability.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Shadow Clones

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nokko

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Protea

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Oraxia

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Baruuk

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Baruuk channels the desert wind to turn his fists and feet into an exalted weapon.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Desert Wind

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Grimoire

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dante

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Oberon

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kullervo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Hydroid

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Harrow

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Cycle through and shoot one of four tactical arrows. Cloak creates a stationary bubble that cloaks Ivara and allies. Dashwire creates a traversable zipline. Noise emits a high-pitched sound that attracts enemies to it. Sleep temporarily puts nearby enemies into a deep slumber.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Quiver

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Artemis Bow

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ivara

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Revenant

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gauss

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Inaros

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Saryn

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Caliban

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Lizzie was born from Flare’s own Techrot-infested blood. More than a mere instrument, she thrums with fire-spitting fury.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Lizzie

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Temple

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Zephyr

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Vauban

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Trinity

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Volt

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Voruna

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Wisp

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Sevagoth's roving spirit, formed from concentrated Void energy.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sevagoth's Shadow

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These razor-sharp blades of condensed Void energy inflict deep and grievous wounds.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Shadow Claws

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sevagoth

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Yareli

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Equinox

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These fish were purposefully contaminated with the Infestation as an Entrati 'experiment'. They feed off the organic deposits in cave systems.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Aquapulmo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Crammed with redundant, mutated internal organs, this pungent fish mingles Orokin and Infested ancestry. It is confined to the Exocrine and is only active by the light of the Wyrm Fass.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ostimyr

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Whatever higher functions this fish once had have been consumed, leaving it a mere automaton of metal and flesh. It ekes out a primitive existence in cave systems.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Vitreospina

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Formerly Orokin scavengers, these fish succumbed to the Infestation long ago and now greedily feast on floating spores. They are found all over the surface of Deimos.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Cryptosuctus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: As ravenous as the Infestation itself, this fish feeds on the remains of others. It shuns the light, preferring an enclosed cave environment.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Barbisteo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Infestation has suborned these fish to its own purposes, using them as antibodies to repel the non-Infested. They swim through and above the Exocrine found on Deimos’ surface.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kymaeros

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These fish hatch out of translucent pods formed in caverns below the Infested landscape. They hover to feed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Amniophysi

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A muscular, three-tailed fish, the Lobotriscid trawls through Exocrine vapor across the surface of Deimos when Vome is dominant.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Lobotriscid

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These specimens were originally parasites, breeding inside the wyrm-guts of Fass and scattered across Deimos in the debris of his explosive demise. They are drawn to his light.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Flagellocanth

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These hefty fish are cannibalistic. They rise by Vome's light to absorb rare gases, retreating when Fass ascends to devour their smaller kin in their lairs.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Glutinox

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This exceptionally rare breed of fish is almost extinct, as its gilded Orokin flesh has a special savor for predators. It warily conceals itself in caves.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Myxostomata

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A living fossil hearkening back to the Orokin era, this elusive fish hides below the surface of Exocrine pools in the deepest caverns it can find. Unlike Infested fish breeds, it has no ability to hover.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Duroid

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A triumph of Orokin bio-engineering, these hardy fish have adapted to the Deimos environment and seem oddly resistant to Infestation. They thrive in cave environments.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Chondricord

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Discharges electricity from luminous glands along its flanks to stun its prey.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Charc Eel

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A predatory fish that is attracted to the scent of blood.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Goopolla

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A cunning hunter that hides within the mud at the bottom of the ocean and ambushes passing prey.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Murkray

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: While rarely venturing from the deepest waters of the plains, the Sharrac is a fearsome predator who will prey on unwary Ostrons swimming alone.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sharrac

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A crustacean that hunts during the twilight hours.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Karkina

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Its gaping maw allows it to scoop up smaller fish as it swims by them.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Mawfish

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A poisonous fish protected by a hardened carapace around its skull.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Khut-Khut

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This slow fish meanders through the waters and is often preyed upon by larger predators.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Yogwun

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Strong, predatory fish with eyes that can pierce the darkest shadows.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tralok

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Displays blood-spattered pattern on its scales and has its ribs exposed through open cavities along both flanks. When predators approach it lies still at the bottom of the sand banks, disguised as a carcass in hopes of being ignored.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Mortus Lungfish

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Glappid is a scavenger that feasts on the remains of dead fish. It has formed a symbiotic bond with the Seram Beetle which extracts and feeds upon any toxins ingested by the Glappid.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Glappid

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This fish inhabits the shallows and feeds of crabs and other small crustaceans. When threatened it forces air into its brain to give it the impression of being much bigger than it normally is.

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A grotesque crustacean that produces a potent, paralyzing toxin from its tentacles.

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Pox

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Twin Basolk

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Rumblejack

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Paracesis

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A custom weapon made from many possible parts. Assembled only by Hok in Cetus.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Zaw

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The offensive component of an Ostron martial weapon.
The shaft or handle of an Ostron martial weapon.
A Zaw Strike used for rapier and polearm style weapons. Its light weight increases speed at the cost of damage.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dehtat

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Zaw Strike used for machete and polearm style weapons.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Cyath

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Zaw Strike used for dagger and staff style weapons. Its light weight increases speed at the cost of damage.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Balla

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Zaw Strike used for machete and polearm style weapons. Its heavy weight increases damage at the cost of Speed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kronsh

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Zaw Strike used for sword and polearm style weapons. Its heavy weight increases damage at the cost of Speed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Mewan

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Zaw Strike used for sword and staff style weapons.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ooltha

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: An Infested rapier-like or polearm strike that also deals <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage. Its light weight provides an increase in Speed at the cost of Damage.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Plague Kripath

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: An Infested scythe or staff head strike that also deals <DT_VIRAL>Viral Damage. Its heavy weight provides an increase in Damage at the cost of Speed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Plague Keewar

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A brace component for an Operator Amp.
A scaffold component for an Operator Amp.
A prism component for an Operator Amp.

A custom Amplifier made from many possible parts. Assembled by:
Quill Onkko in Cetus
Little Duck in Fortuna
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Amp

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Venato

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gammacor

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Afuris

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akbolto

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akbronco

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A Viper equipped in each hand.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Twin Vipers

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Aklex

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akmagnus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akvasto

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: <ARCHWING> Veritux

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Corufell

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dual Decurion

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Imperator

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Corvas

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Grattler

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Larkspur

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Cernos

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Daikyu

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Cernos

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Paris

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nataruk

ClientItemParentLocalization.description:
Standard tool for cutting ore and gems out of stone.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nosam Cutter

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Grimoire

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tigris

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tiberon

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Rubico

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nagantaka

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Alternox

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Panthera

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Zhuge

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Phantasma

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Acceltra

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Stradavar

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire’s precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Cedo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tenora

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Astilla

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Corinth

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Styanax’s speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Afentis

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sybaris

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Steflos

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Scourge

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Perigale

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Baza

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Fulmin

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Scindo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dual Zoren

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sarofang

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kogake

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Venka

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dark Dagger

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Fang

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dual Kamas

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Furax

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tekko

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ankyros

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kestrel

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Glaive

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gram

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Redeemer

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Power Strike slams Sampotes into the ground to damage enemies with a shockwave that inflicts <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sampotes

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Volnus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Fragor

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Skana

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Magistar

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ninkondi

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Guandao Prime

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Orthos

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Guandao

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Bo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tipedo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Bo

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nami Skyla

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Power Strike lifts enemies into the air and unleashes a flurry of deadly slashes.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Syam

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Azothane

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Galatine

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Nikana

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Karyst

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Pangolin Sword

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Dual Keres

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Lacera

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: War

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Okina

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Masseter

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Destreza

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Tatsu

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Block to activate its staggering energy shield. Power Strike stuns enemies and inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Perfect Parry restores your Power Strike.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Argo & Vel

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Silva & Aegis

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Cobra & Crane

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Boltace

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kronen

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Quassus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gunsen

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Furis

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sicarus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Bronco

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Lex

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Lato

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Vasto

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Ballistica

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Zylok

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Magnus

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Hystrix

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akarius

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Pyrana

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Aksomati

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akstiletto

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Akjagara

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Pandero

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Zakti

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Athodai

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Velox

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Knell

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Epitaph

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kompressa

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Vectis

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Boltor

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Burston

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Gorgon

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Braton

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Latron

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Snipetron

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Soma

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Vectis

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Sobek

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Boar

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Hek

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Strun

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Kunai

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Spira

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Castanas

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Hikou

ClientItemParentLocalization.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.
ClientItemParentLocalization.name: Trumna
